rows.character: High,--white, fixed. Low,--white, flashing, 5 s. interval

rows.name: Royal Sovereign light vessel
rows.character: White, group flashing, 3 flashes every minute

rows.name: Beachy Head
rows.character: White, revolving; bright 15 seconds, eclipsed 1 minute 45 seconds

rows.name: Owers light vessel
rows.character: White and red, revolving, twice white, once red, half-minute interval

rows.name: Needles Rock, Isle of Wight
rows.character: White, occulting, half-minute interval, with red and green sectors, red

rows.name: Shambles light vessel
rows.character: White, group flashing, 2 flashes every half-minute

rows.name: Start Point
rows.character: White, revolving, one minute interval; white, fixed, in same tower

rows.name: Plymouth Breakwater
rows.character: White to seaward, red over anchorage, occulting, half-minute interval; white, fixed, in same tower

rows.name: Eddystone--2 lights
rows.character: White, group flashing, two flashes every half-minute; white, fixed, in same tower

rows.name: Falmouth, St. Anthony's Point
rows.character: White, revolving, 20 seconds interval; white, fixed, in same tower
